# Read-order file: the engine picks the FIRST valid levy across all levy
# files in name order, so the prefix encodes this file's unlock age
# exactly like vanilla (00_revolutions ... 05_traditions). The extra 0
# after the prefix sorts us before the vanilla file of the same age.
# Do NOT merge tags' levies back into a single 00_ file: that shadows
# every newer vanilla levy forever. Generated by
# scripts/migrate_levy_age_files.py.

# Pontic Akrites: akritic mountain frontier infantry. Heavy, defensive,
# drawn from upland villagers of the Pontic Alps.
levy_nd_pon_akrites = {
	size = levy_generic_infantry_size
	unit = a_nd_pon_akrites

	allowed_pop_type = peasants
	allowed_pop_type = soldiers
	allowed_pop_type = laborers

	country_allow = {
		has_or_had_tag = PON
	}
}
